skill.name: impeccable
skill.description: Design, critique, polish, and iterate frontend interfaces with structured UX guidance, local audits, and optional live browser workflows.
skill.summary: Frontend UI design assistant for audits, polish, design systems, responsive fixes, and live iteration.
skill.author: pbakaus

security_audit.summary: The audit dismisses widespread static noise from Markdown examples, detector regexes, and minified syntax, but confirms real risks in executable local tooling. The skill can read and write project files, open localhost services, perform network calls, capture annotated UI screenshots, and spawn AI subprocesses with approval-bypass modes and inherited environment variables.

remediation.issue: Approval-bypassing AI subprocesses inherit the full environment.
remediation.suggestion: Remove bypass modes by default, require explicit user consent, and pass a minimal allowlisted environment to Codex or Claude child processes.

remediation.issue: The skill manifest allows broad Bash access to npx and every local script.
remediation.suggestion: Replace wildcard tool permissions with named commands and document which scripts may write files, start servers, or call external services.

remediation.issue: Live mode captures and stores annotated UI screenshots.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear consent step, redact sensitive text by default, and avoid screenshots on pages that contain secrets or customer data.

remediation.issue: Several scripts run shell commands or spawned processes.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer execFileSync or spawn with fixed argument arrays, validate all user-controlled inputs, and avoid shell command strings.

remediation.issue: The context loader performs an outbound update check.
remediation.suggestion: Make update checks opt-in for marketplace installs, document the endpoint, and disable network calls in offline or restricted environments.

content.value_statement: Frontend teams need sharper UI decisions without losing project context. Impeccable combines design guidance, audits, polish workflows, and local iteration tools.
actual_capabilities: Routes UI work through focused commands such as craft, audit, critique, polish, harden, and live.
Loads PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md context before making design decisions.
Reviews typography, spacing, layout, color, motion, accessibility, and responsive behavior.
Runs local detector scripts for common frontend design anti-patterns.
Supports live browser selection, annotations, variants, and manual edit workflows.
limitations: Requires local Node scripts for many workflows.
Live mode can start a localhost server and capture selected UI screenshots.
Not intended for backend-only or non-UI tasks.
Best results depend on accurate product context and existing design files.

use_cases.title: Audit an Existing Screen
use_cases.description: Review a page for hierarchy, contrast, responsiveness, motion, accessibility, and visual polish before release.

use_cases.title: Shape a New Feature
use_cases.description: Turn a feature request into a clear interface direction with layout, copy, state, and component guidance.

use_cases.title: Maintain a Design System
use_cases.description: Extract patterns, document visual rules, and reduce inconsistent components across a frontend project.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Impeccable to critique the current dashboard page. Focus on contrast, spacing, hierarchy, and responsive behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Polish a Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Impeccable polish on the onboarding flow. Keep the existing brand, but improve copy, empty states, and visual rhythm.

prompt_templates.title: Shape Before Building
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Impeccable shape for a settings page redesign. Define the layout direction, states, interactions, and design constraints before code changes.

prompt_templates.title: Run Live Iteration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Impeccable live on the product detail route. Select the hero section, annotate the main issue, and generate three distinct visual directions.

output_examples.input: Critique this landing page for launch readiness.
output_examples.output: A prioritized design review with severity levels, concrete visual issues, responsive risks, and recommended fixes.

output_examples.input: Polish the checkout form without changing the brand.

output_examples.output: A focused UI direction covering page structure, data hierarchy, interaction states, empty states, and implementation priorities.

best_practices: Start with a narrow target, such as one route, component, or flow.
Keep PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md current before broad redesign work.
Review live mode permissions before capturing annotated UI screenshots.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for backend-only tasks or infrastructure work.
Do not run live mode on pages that show secrets or private customer data.
Do not accept large visual changes without checking responsive and accessibility impact.

faq.question: What is Impeccable best for?
faq.answer: It is best for frontend design critique, UI polish, design-system guidance, and live visual iteration.

faq.question: Does it write code?
faq.answer: It can guide and support code changes through local scripts and workflows when the host agent allows those tools.

faq.question: Does live mode use the network?
faq.answer: Yes. Live mode uses a localhost server and browser requests to exchange UI events and annotations.

faq.question: Can it inspect project files?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill reads project context and design files, and some workflows read or write local frontend files.

faq.question: Is it suitable for sensitive applications?
faq.answer: Use caution. Avoid live screenshots or broad script permissions on pages that display secrets or regulated data.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill workflows.
